about: The Workbench icons of the Cytopia drawer: python3 AMICRADLE/scripts/ports/port_icons.py amiga/icons/icons.json --out amiga/icons (DalsinAI/amicradle). The art (art/cytopia.svg, drawn as an OS 3.5 GlowIcon: an isometric city block) is The AmiCradle Team's own, MIT like the other Amiga files; art/cytopia.png is it rendered at 128 x 128. Cytopia-drawer.info is the drawer's own icon, Cytopia.info beside the drawer. ReadMe.info is also copied for ReadMe-Cytopia, Credits and COPYING.txt; Data.info is the User drawer's icon.
